function_declarations.name: check_stock
function_declarations.description: Call this to check the database if there is available stock for a given SKU before deciding to swap or abort.

function_declarations.name: swap_item
function_declarations.description: Call this when there is available stock in the database. This will swap the item and update inventory.

function_declarations.name: abort_order
function_declarations.description: Call this when there is NO stock left in the database. This will abort the order.

sku.description: The Product SKU that is out of stock

function_declarations.name: report_damage_only
function_declarations.description: Call this when a picker finds a damaged item but it does NOT affect their current order. This purely moves the damaged stock to QA without touching the current order.

sku.description: The Product SKU that is damaged

function_declarations.name: calc_packaging
function_declarations.description: Call this to query dimensions of items in the order to calculate the required box size.

function_declarations.name: return_to_shelf
function_declarations.description: Call this to return a mispicked item back to the shelf.

sku.description: The Product SKU that was mispicked

function_declarations.name: request_repick
function_declarations.description: Call this to create a task for a picker to fetch a missing or correct item.

sku.description: The Product SKU that is missing and needs to be picked
